red_readhead_fits.pro

Routines

top source red_readhead_fits

SST pipeline

result = red_readhead_fits(fname, date_beg=strarr, extension=extension, framenumbers=intarr, select_frame=int, silent=silent [, status=integer])

Return the header from a FITS format file, taking some pipeline-specific issues into account.

Return value

Parameters

fname in type=string

The name of the data file.

Keywords

date_beg out type=strarr

The timestamps for exposure start.

extension
framenumbers out type=intarr

The framenumbers extracted from the file metadata.

select_frame in type=int

Only get meta-data for a specific frame. (TODO: implement)

silent
status out optional type=integer

0 is succeeded, -1 otherwise.
